ruling: The published main snapshot is byte-identical to an ancestor tree already in review-branch history. Record its commit ancestry using the ours merge strategy while preserving the current descendant tree. This is a merge into the review branch, not publication to main or deployment.
risk_if_wrong: An unverified upstream difference could be discarded; both complete-tree equality and ancestor reachability are asserted before merging.
scope: Published main ancestry integrated into the review branch; this is not a merge of the review branch into main or a deployment.
verification: Full published-tree equality to a reachable review ancestor, clean tracked index/worktree before merging, identical before/after review trees, empty first-parent file diff, and main ancestor reachability after merging were checked.
